夫君给后宫娘子军的信！（夫君给后宫娘子军的信！（第22页）罗妈妈看到阿九眼中闪耀的光芒，心中百感交集，若是成了，何尝不是最好的结果，可若是不成。。。她赶紧摇头，不会不成的，王妃当年就算无遗策，阿九她，越来越像王妃了。老九拿出的地图，不是别的，正是他用神兽之皮，亲手绘制的。他在海上几个月的漂泊可不是白过的，加上现实之中已知的大陆，他几乎把整个海域的情况补了个七七八八。连连过去几个关卡，而那些弟子，长老看到钟望雪无不是纷纷拜见。“刘，你出来，咱俩聊聊。”睡得正香，松鼠那熟悉的声音，在刘云轩的脑海中响起。现在的情况已经不是自已能够控制地了~！只有走一步算一步了，搏一搏了。手里地飞剑紧了紧，体内真元勃发，暗中准备着，趁机而动。谢星知道是因为他袖箭射中的位置不是要害，趁这人还没有彻底转过身来之前，想也不想就再次扑了上去，一拳打在他的腰间肋骨。进去的数百人当中，竟然只有这些人活着出来了？残酷的世界往往如此，进来这里的数万人，最终活下来的不到半百之数，尽皆陨落于此。整个六十八人间界，因为楚岩的归来，那紧张凝固的气氛瞬间消失，化为了只有感动和喜悦。“这次世家大会。三王子觉得如何？”在三王子项天明的府诋里，乐进坐于项天明右手边，问道。其余一个个，在略一愣神后。也是跟着哭喊着，嘶声裂肺的哭着。从来没有这一刻，让她们感受到了希望。而刘青似乎也是挺争气，手指头动的越来越频繁，到最后，右手竟然紧紧的握在了一起。

The husband’s letter to the women in the harem! (Letter from husband to the women in the harem! (Page 22) Mother Luo saw the shining light in Ah Jiu's eyes and had mixed feelings in her heart. If it works, it wouldn't be the best result, but if it doesn't work... She quickly shook her head, it won't happen. Yes, even if the princess had no plans back then, Ah Jiu was becoming more and more like the princess. The map that Lao Jiu took out was none other than the one he drew with his own hands using the skin of a mythical beast. His months of wandering at sea were not in vain, plus the reality. He almost made up for the situation in the entire sea area, and passed several levels in a row. When the disciples and elders saw Zhong Wangxue, they all paid their respects. "Liu, come out and let's talk." He was sleeping soundly. The familiar voice of the squirrel sounded in Liu Yunxuan's mind. The situation was no longer under his control~! He only had to take one step at a time and give it a try. He tightened his grip on the flying sword and secretly prepared himself. He took advantage of the opportunity. Xie Xing knew that the location where his sleeve arrow hit was not a critical point. Before the man could turn around completely, he pounced on him again and punched him in the ribs. Among the hundreds of people who entered, only these people came out alive? This is often the case in a cruel world. Only half a hundred of the tens of thousands who entered here died. The entire sixty-eight human world was so tense because of Chu Yan's return. The atmosphere disappeared instantly and turned into only emotion and joy. "How do you feel about this family meeting?" Le Jin sat on Xiang Tianming's right side in the palace of the third prince. The others also cried loudly after a moment of confusion. Never before did they feel hopeful. Liu Qing seemed to be very confident, and his hands moved more and more frequently, and in the end, their right hands were held together tightly.
